coverage_explanation: Preserves the previous assertions and adds 250 ms welcome and LED-activation checks, anchored welcome matching, buzzer activity checks, far-only startup checks, 9 cm/11 cm threshold coverage, and tighter standby observations. D6 edge checks reject a completely silent implementation but cannot distinguish exactly three short carrier bursts using the available check schemas. Numeric definitions of rapid flashing and short beeps remain unspecified; the suite does not invent them. Sustained-proximity retrigger behavior and behavior throughout the five-second absence interval are also not sufficiently specified to impose additional exact traces. Exact 10 cm boundary behavior remains excluded.
assumptions: Relies on the bench default active-HIGH D13 LED wired through a resistor to GND.
D6 is a passive tone output, consistent with the authoritative tone_output role; carrier edges demonstrate electrical buzzer activation, not physical sound.
Standby is interpreted as LED OFF and buzzer silent.
Distances of 9 cm and 11 cm test either side of the threshold without resolving exactly 10 cm.
The public 250 ms reaction bound is applied to welcome reporting and initiation of LED and buzzer activity, not to completion of all three beeps.
The reference chooses 100 ms LED half-periods and 100 ms beep/gap durations; these are implementation choices, not acceptance thresholds.
The reference rearms after standby. Retrigger behavior during sustained proximity is unspecified.
Post-timeout hold windows begin after a 250 ms response allowance and therefore do not assert that boundary transitions are forbidden.
